transcript.en: Is it a true story?
No, it's really true.
So, when I was young, I used to live in the country.
And you know, in the country, all of the neighbors know each other.
transcript.zh: 你知道，在乡下，邻居们都互相认识。

transcript.en: It's a small community, so everyone knows what's happening all the time.
transcript.zh: 那是一个小社区，所以每个人都知道发生了什么事。

transcript.en: And there was some gossip going on in our community about a guy who lived at the end of the road.
transcript.zh: 我们社区里有一些关于住在路尽头一个男人的八卦。

transcript.en: And he was the owner of a car wrecking yard.
transcript.zh: 他是一个废车场的老板。

transcript.en: So a place where you take old broken down cars and take the parts apart to sell.
transcript.zh: 就是那种把废旧破车拆开、把零件卖出去的地方。

transcript.en: Right.
And anyway, a scrap yard.
Yeah, a scrap yard.
All right.
Okay, so, you know, he had a wife and a couple of kids.
transcript.zh: 好的，你知道，他有妻子和几个孩子。

transcript.en: And suddenly his wife disappeared.
transcript.zh: 然后突然他的妻子失踪了。

transcript.en: Wow.
Yeah.
And no one knew what happened or anything.
transcript.zh: 没有人知道发生了什么。

transcript.en: And so several years pass and suddenly the police start coming in and start investigating this guy and start digging up all of the land around his property.
transcript.zh: 几年过去了，突然警察开始介入，开始调查这个人，并在他房子周围挖地。

transcript.en: And I guess, I don't know what they're doing, but I think they were looking for the wife's body.
transcript.zh: 我猜，我也不知道他们在干什么，但我想他们是在寻找他妻子的尸体。

transcript.en: Wow.
And did they find it?
I don't know.
I moved away.
Oh, such a great story, but we don't know how it ends.
transcript.zh: 哦，故事很精彩，但我们不知道结局如何。

transcript.en: Yeah.
Well, we can leave it up to the imagination of our listeners.
transcript.zh: 好吧，我们可以留给听众去想象。

transcript.en: Exactly.
Maybe they were looking for an old car.
transcript.zh: 也许他们是在找一辆旧车。

transcript.en: An old car buried in the ground.
I don't think so.
All right.
That's a true story.
Real English, real stories.
You heard it first here on EnglishPod.
transcript.zh: 你最先在 EnglishPod 听到的。

transcript.en: All right.
So, we want to hear your comments and suggestions about this topic.
transcript.zh: 我们想听听你们对这个话题的评论和建议。

transcript.en: I bet a lot of our listeners also have creepy stories, maybe ghost stories, maybe, I don't know, different types of weird stories.
transcript.zh: 我敢说很多听众也有恐怖故事，也许是鬼故事，也许是，我也不知道，各种类型的诡异故事。

transcript.en: So, you guys should definitely log on to EnglishPod and share them with us.
transcript.zh: 所以你们一定要登录 EnglishPod 和我们分享。

transcript.en: That's right.
Go to EnglishPod.com and in the comment section of the website, tell us your creepy stories.
transcript.zh: 去 EnglishPod.com，在网站的评论区告诉我们你的恐怖故事。

transcript.en: And we're going to pick out the best story as the story of the week.
transcript.zh: 我们会选出最佳故事作为本周故事。

transcript.en: We'll announce it in our This Just In podcast.
transcript.zh: 我们会在 This Just In 播客中公布。

transcript.en: Yes.
So, we want to hear all your juicy stories and gossip maybe as well.
transcript.zh: 所以，我们想听你们所有的劲爆故事，也许还有一些八卦。

transcript.en: Yes.
All right.
Well, it's time for us to go.
So, be sure to listen to us next time.
transcript.zh: 下次一定要继续收听我们。

transcript.en: But until then, it's...
Bye-bye.
Bye.

dialogue.en: A: Oh, I don't know if you heard, but someone moved into that old house down the road.
dialogue.zh: A：哦，不知道你听说了没，有人搬进了路那头的老房子。

dialogue.en: B: Yeah, I know.
B: I met the owner of the house yesterday as he was moving in.
dialogue.zh: B：昨天他搬进来的时候我见到房主了。

dialogue.en: B: His name is Armand.
A: Really?
A: What's he like?
A: You have to fill me in.
B: Actually, he's a bit strange.
B: I don't know... I've got a bad feeling about him.
dialogue.zh: B：我也说不好…我对他有种不好的预感。

dialogue.en: A: Really?
A: Why?
B: Well, yesterday I brought over a housewarming gift,but Armand started acting really weird, and then he practically kicked me out!
dialogue.zh: B：嗯，昨天我带了一份乔迁礼物过去，但阿尔芒表现得很奇怪，然后几乎把我赶了出来！

dialogue.en: B: I tried to, sort of, peek into his house, but everything was so dark inside that I couldn't really get a good look.
dialogue.zh: B：我试着，算是，偷看了一下他房子里面，但是里面太暗了，我根本看不清。

dialogue.en: A: Well, you'll never guess what I saw this morning.
dialogue.zh: A：嗯，你绝对猜不到我今天早上看到什么了。

dialogue.en: A: A delivery truck pulled into his driveway, and it dropped off a long, rectangular box.
dialogue.zh: A：一辆送货车开进了他的车道，卸下了一个又长又方的盒子。

dialogue.en: A: It almost looked like a coffin!
dialogue.zh: A：看起来几乎像一口棺材！

dialogue.en: B: You see!
B: Why would he...
C: Hello ladies...
B: Ah, Armand!
B: You scared the heck out of me!
B: This is my friend Doris.
C: A pleasure to meet you... If you are not doing anything tonight, I would like to have you both for dinner.
dialogue.zh: C：很高兴见到你…如果你们今晚没什么事的话，我想请你们两个来吃晚饭。

dialogue.en: C: I mean... I would like to have you both over for dinner.
dialogue.zh: C：我的意思是…我想请你们两个过来吃晚饭。

title: Daily Life - New Guy in Town
